notes.title: Improved valve's Index Controller Support
notes.content:
- Improved valve's Index Controller Support 
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Improved Nostalgia Arcade VR.
notes.content:
Nostalgia Arcade VR is now much better! 
[list]
[*] We have updated the Nostalgia Arcade VR room: Now it is graphically better and it is easier to navigate and access the demos of the other VR games.
[*] Fixed a problem with record lists.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick update fix #2
notes.content: Just a new quick update to fix bugs. Thanks for reporting it!

notes.title: Quick update fix
notes.content: Just a quick update to fix bugs

notes.title: Arcade mode completed!
notes.content:
We are pleased with the result obtained in this new mode specially created after receiving feedback from the community. We hope you like it a lot!
- All arcade levels completed.
- Improved menu interface.
- Final adjustments in several levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315956/6f0f5d0373518075b327c375bf372b1ac1fba3e3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fixed problem with classic controls
notes.content: fixed problem with classic controls and other minor bug fixes

notes.title: 2 new levels in arcade mode: 7 and 8.
notes.content:
- 2 new levels in arcade mode: 7 and 8.
- Improvements in level 6 of the arcade mode.
- Some arcade mode difficulty adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: 2 new levels for Arcade mode
notes.content:
- 2 new levels for Arcade mode.
- Improved the support for classic controllers: Now they can also be used in the menus.
- Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Arcade mode update
notes.content:
- Arcade mode is now compatible with classic controllers (Xbox, PS, etc.) in a few days, all the menus can also be used.
- Independent record lists for arcade mode.
- In arcade mode, life is now displayed just below the character.
- Graphical improvements, various adjustments, and several bugs corrected.
- Now, you can adjust the sensitivity of the control in options.

notes.title: Redesign of camera changes and new luminosity option
notes.content:
- Redesign of the camera changes in the first 3 levels to facilitate the assimilation of the controls.
- New option to adjust the luminosity of the game in advanced settings.
- Several adjustments in some bosses.
- Small improvements in the Demo version of the game.
- Several minor bugs were fixed.

notes.title: Retry the boss, control preferences, and more
notes.content:
- Now, you can retry the boss one time (except in the extreme difficulty mode) by inserting the coins accumulated in the game.
- If you choose the same control preference in the immersion zones three times in a row, you will not be asked again.
- Improvements in the optional motion control mode, designed for non-stick controls (Vive wand).
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Various improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
- The laser shots in the level don't kill you now in one touch (except for the boss).
- Improved game-ending (although the surprise is not ready yet).
- Rearview sensitivity adjusted.
- Some graphical improvements.
- Several bug fixes.

notes.title: Improvements and final adjustments in some bosses and immersion zones
notes.content:
- Improvements and final adjustments in some bosses and immersion zones.
- More polished transitions between levels.
- We are working on a new surprise for the end of the game. Stay tuned! ;-)

notes.title: Some Bosses improved, new option to replay a level, and more
notes.content:
- Level 2 boss improved.
- Level 9 boss improved.
- New option to replay a level without going through the menu.
- Adjusted some missions and stars.
- Improvements in some sounds and music.
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Quest demo released and huge version updates!
notes.content:
We have released the Oculus Quest native version of the 2076 Demo and we have also added many important new features that we have been able to realize thanks to your great feedback:
[list]
[*] Now you can choose the difficulty at which you want to play each level to satisfy all types of players.
[*] Better control of the ship in immersion zones.
[*] The entry points of the immersion zones are visually clearer.
[*] Fixed some small bugs.
[/list]
Download the Quest version here: 
https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4504829629531931
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315956/6b266d123ccb2634c8726ae165684ccd5150807e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: We've made a big update to the VR DEMO of 2076 Midway Multiverse
notes.content:
We've made a big update to the #VR #DEMO of 2076 Midway Multiverse:
[list]
[*]  Better lighting and fog effects.
[*]  Better explanation of how the novel virtual shield works with the right hand.
[*]  Improved control in immersion zones: now the ship responds better to turns.
[*]  Improved control with the grip-3D.
[*]  Now you can check the games of the Nostalgia-VR arcade from the screen of each arcade.
[*]  Adjusted and improved some camera changes.
[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315956/74d18165d4af5c68e4a5c979172cd626ef2484b6.png[/img]
